crossRefs.note: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.
The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

translations.web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”
translations.bsb: The slacker says, “A lion is in the road! A fierce lion roams the public square!”
translations.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
translations.asv: The sluggard saith, There is a lion in the way; A lion is in the streets.
